architecture: MiMoV2ForCausalLM (hybrid full/sliding-window GQA, MoE; text stack of the multimodal RL checkpoint)

upstream_head.note: hub tree diff 3b38d06..5711b26: every safetensors blob, config.json, tokenizer and chat template are identical; dflash/config.json gained its invalid-JSON fix (trailing comma) at b2674c7

same_geometry_variant.status: not downloaded; serving it needs a download, a census and new packs

sources.host_geometry: model-families/mimo26/include/sparkpipe/spark_mimo26_model.h, derived 2026-09-22 from the released config.json, modeling_mimo_v2.py and the safetensors shard headers; rechecked 2026-09-28 against revision 3b38d063 and the hub head 5711b268
sources.contract_note: transcribed from the family header and census so tools/generate_recipe.py has one authoritative JSON per served model; the header remains the ground truth the C side compiles against and tests/test_mimo26_census.py binds the two
sources.precision_policy: routed experts MXFP4 (e2m1 weights, e8m0 scales, 32-element blocks) exactly as trained; fp8 e4m3 linear weights with F32 scale_inv per [128,128] block; o_proj, embeddings, lm_head, norms and sink biases BF16 byte-identical to source; router gate and bias BF16/F32 as stored; GEMM accumulation FP32; NO requantization anywhere

scope.vision_tower: present in checkpoint, out of scope
scope.audio_encoder: present in checkpoint, out of scope

hybrid_attention.layer_kind_note: SPARK_MIMO26_MODEL_LAYER_KIND in the family header; sink-bias tensor count 39 equals the SWA layer count
hybrid_attention.sliding_window_rule: a SWA query at position p attends keys p-127..p (128 keys including itself), transformers create_sliding_window_causal_mask

attention.rope_rule: rope_dimension = int(head_dimension * 0.334) = 64; rotate_half over the first 64 dims of q and k, the remaining 128 dims unrotated
attention.sink_rule: SWA layers append one learned logit per query head to the softmax row and drop its probability; full layers have no sink

moe.router_logits: fp32 matmul of the bf16 hidden and bf16 gate weight (moe_router_dtype bfloat16)
moe.selection_rule: top-8 of sigmoid(logit) + e_score_correction_bias; weights are the unbiased sigmoid scores divided by their sum + 1e-20

precision.qkv_scale_row_rule: measured per-arm constants (block-128 scale_inv grids; the upstream emitter's row padding is not a clean closed form, so the module and packer pin the measured values: pro 216/216, flash 108/116)

cache.kv_element_source: KV is cached pre-scaled BF16 (value scale folded before the cache write); SWA layers cache 128-token windows only

mtp.layer_kind: SWA attention with sink bias + fp8 dense MLP, eh_proj/enorm/hnorm fusion

dflash.config_note: the warm dflash/config.json at 3b38d06 is invalid JSON (trailing comma); the hub fixed it at b2674c7 and the fixed file is the one to load

speculation.status: not served; speculative and non-speculative results are reported separately

out_of_scope_regions_v1.note: documented with byte ranges in the census, retained in source, not stripped; the v1 driver serves the non-speculative text tower only
